name: Nihao! Shoukou
source:
There is a legend that it's possible to become a wizard upon reaching 25 years and remaining virgin. Main character witnesses magic abilities of a 47-year office worker, so decides to become a wizard as well. Besides, he is 24 year and 11 months old already. However, he develops really promising relations with a girl he likes, so he has to choose which path to take. At the same time three maidens appear who want to stop protagonist from becoming a wizard and thus try to seduce him with all means possible. Can he protect his precious virginity !?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
传说只要年满二十五岁仍保持童贞，就能成为魔法师。主人公亲眼见到一名四十七岁的上班族施展魔法，于是也决定成为魔法师。况且，他已经二十四岁零十一个月。然而，他与喜欢的女孩发展出很有希望的关系，不得不选择该走哪条路。与此同时，三名少女出现，想阻止主人公成为魔法师，便用尽各种手段勾引他。他能守住宝贵的童贞吗！？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
